name: 01_horn
prompt: A deep low ship horn sounding once across open water, long and mournful, with a faint harbour reverb tail and gentle water lapping underneath

name: 02_bell
prompt: An old mechanical warning bell ringing steadily on a bridge, bright metallic clanging at a regular pace, outdoors with a little open-air echo

name: 03_gears
prompt: A large slow gear train engaging under heavy load, deep metallic meshing and a steady low grinding rotation, massive and unhurried

name: 04_bolts
prompt: Four heavy steel bolts sliding out of their housings and seating hard into sockets, solid metallic scrape then a decisive clunk, close and dry

name: 05_steam
prompt: A Victorian steam engine room: a beam engine turning steadily, rhythmic hiss of steam escaping, a coal fire crackling and brass valves ticking

name: 06_harbour
prompt: A calm harbour on a bright afternoon: gentle water against a quay, distant gulls, a light breeze and faint rigging clinking, no voices
